description: A seam verb the host has wired no dispatch for still SETTLES the ActionOutcome the page asked for: the record becomes `{status: "error", code: "ACTION_DISPATCH_UNWIRED"}`, never `ok` (which would report an act that did not occur) and never left `pending` (which would hang a control on a request nobody sent). The document is conformant — whether a host wired a seam is not a property of the document — so the refusal is a rendered outcome, not a validation rejection.
